{{Short description|Optimization method in numerical analysis}}
{{Orphan|date=October 2016}}

The [[Bregman method|Bregman]]-[[Joseph-Louis Lagrange|Lagrangian]] framework permits a systematic understanding of the matching rates associated with higher-order [[gradient method]]s in discrete and continuous time.<ref name="Michael I. Jordan">{{cite journal |title=A variational perspective on accelerated methods in optimization |date=March 14, 2016 |arxiv=1603.04245v1 |last1=Wibisono |first1=Andre |last2=Wilson |first2=Ashia C. |last3=Jordan |first3=Michael I. |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences |volume=113 |issue=47 |pages=E7351–E7358 |doi=10.1073/pnas.1614734113 |pmid=27834219 |bibcode=2016PNAS..113E7351W |doi-access=free |pmc=5127379 }}</ref> Based on [[Bregman divergence]], the Lagrangian is a continuous time dynamical system whose [[Euler-Lagrange equation]]s can be linked to [[Stochastic_gradient_descent#Momentum|Nesterov's accelerated gradient]] method for gradient-based optimization.<ref name="Zhang2021">{{cite book |last1=Zhang |first1=Peiyuan |last2=Orvieto |first2=Antonio |last3=Daneshmand |first3=Hadi |title=Rethinking the Variational Interpretation of Accelerated Optimization Methods |date=2021 |publisher=Curran Associates, Inc. |pages=14396–14406 |url=https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2021/hash/788d986905533aba051261497ecffcbb-Abstract.html |access-date=17 December 2024}}</ref> The associated Bregman [[Hamiltonian mechanics|Hamiltonian]] allows for practical implementation of numerical discretizations.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bravetti |first1=Alessandro |last2=Daza-Torres |first2=Maria L. |last3=Flores-Arguedas |first3=Hugo |last4=Betancourt |first4=Michael |title=Bregman dynamics, contact transformations and convex optimization |journal=Information Geometry |date=June 2023 |volume=6 |issue=1 |pages=355–377 |doi=10.1007/s41884-023-00105-0|doi-access=free |arxiv=1912.02928 }}</ref> The approach has been generalized to optimization on [[Riemannian manifolds]].<ref name="Duruisseaux2022">{{cite journal |last1=Duruisseaux |first1=Valentin |last2=Leok |first2=Melvin |title=A Variational Formulation of Accelerated Optimization on Riemannian Manifolds |journal=SIAM Journal on Mathematics of Data Science |date=June 2022 |volume=4 |issue=2 |pages=649–674 |doi=10.1137/21M1395648|arxiv=2101.06552 }}</ref>
